verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships an official MCP server (meilisearch-mcp on PyPI) documented to let agents create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches via natural language prompts, and a runtime probe confirms a real stdio JSON-RPC handshake with the server. However the MCP docs describe index/search/config operations but do not explicitly expose the analytics/click-tracking surface as an agent tool, and there's no independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the MCP server in real agent workflows. Missing for 10: explicit MCP-exposed analytics/reporting operations, and independent hands-on validation beyond the single runtime probe.
